title: Catalyst Sandbox

text.TAG: Mix atoms, spark reactions, and watch molecules form, freeze, melt and boil
text.FREE: The full sandbox: drop in any atoms, heat and squeeze them, and set off reactions
text.WATCH: A tour of exploding hydrogen, freezing water, a salt crystal, the Haber process and the primordial soup
text.FOOT: Simplified but real chemistry: atoms bond by their valence, reactions need activation energy, energy is released or absorbed, and temperature is just atoms moving.
text.FIND: Find or add a molecule or element…
text.HINT: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom · click an atom to see its molecule
text.CANVAS_LABEL: The lab box: drag to look around, scroll to zoom
